messages:
marco_platform: quick thoughtwe need a safe plan for switching default routing from org-first -> project-first for new orgs. quotas and dashboard owners freak out when attribution flips.
anya_pm: Agreed. Primary ask from customers: predictable billing and a clear preview of impact before they opt-in.
lee_sre: Operational constraints: quota enforcement happens in the edge proxy; if routing semantics change, we might see transient overages due to racey cache state. need throttles.
sophia_dev: Proposed flow: 1) nonblocking dark-run where routing choice is computed and logged but not applied; 2) preview API that returns projected quota/billing delta per org; 3) opt-in toggle with preview; 4) enforcement after 30d opt-in window.
raj_auth: Implementation note: store routing.preference as org metadata enum (project|org|legacy). But use a targeting layer to gradually rollouts (percent X of traffic). keeps UI simple and rollout flexible.
metrics-bot: Heads up: adding routing.preference label to many metrics will increase series. Recommend emitting an aggregated counter (no label) plus sampled detailed events with label.
marco_platform: concrete canary idea: 2% of auth requests in eu-central for 12h, then 10% global for 48h. watch quota-deny-rate and billing attribution delta.
deploy-bot: canary scheduled: 2% eu-central tag=auth-route-dark-2026-03-23.
lee_sre: Rollback triggers: quota-deny-rate increase >0.4% sustained for 10m OR billing attribution shift >1.5% for 30m OR auth error rate x3 baseline. auto-revert canary.
sophia_dev: preview API signature: GET /orgs/:org_id/routing/preview?v=30d -> returns {estimated_quota_change, estimated_billing_diff, samples}. we'll return only aggregated strings in UI.
anya_pm: UI copy should avoid technical terms; show 3-line summary + expand for details. include a link to the runbook.
raj_auth: auth path detail: when key lacks project claim we try lookup->project mapping; negative cache TTL=60s; emit metric auth.routing.negative_miss. we should also publish a webhook when project binding changes to invalidate caches.
metrics-bot: Added metrics: auth.routing.negative_miss (counter), auth.routing.decision_sampled (event). Detailed events sampled at 0.5% by default.
lee_sre: Concern: billing teams will need an offline reconciliation job for first 7 days post-cutover to correct any misattributed invoices. schedule finance notify.
marco_platform: Yes, add finance@ to rollout comms. Also add a dashboard tile comparing "last 7d org attribution vs projected" and a heatmap of top 50 keys that change attribution.
sophia_dev: small snippet for dark-logging config: ```yaml
routing:
  mode: dark
  decision_log: true
  sample_rate: 0.005
```
raj_auth: Edge case: some customers use org keys intentionally to share across projects. If we flip defaults, we must ensure their org-wide quotas aren't accidentally split. Preview modal should show "shared key risk" note.
anya_pm: Add a one-click revert in the console for that org that moves them back to legacy behavior while we investigate.
metrics-bot: Suggest instrumenting a "project-split-risk" score and surfacing top offenders in the alert - helps SRE prioritize.
marco_platform: Owners: Marco=rollout plan + finance comms, Raj=auth impl + cache invalidation webhook, Lee=SRE alerts + rollback automation, Sophia=preview API + console modal, Anya=copy + customer comms.
deploy-bot: canary started: 2% eu-central healthy at 15m. no anomalies so far.
marco_platform: OK will draft the PR today. tagging this thread for the rollout doc. :spiral_note_pad:
